name: index_lookup
description: Looks up the DLD Rental Index for the caller's building and bedroom type and returns DLD's rental range, the Decree 43 of 2013 Article 1 maximum increase, the maximum new rent and the clause, calculated by the server. Also checks the 90 day notice rule when both dates are given. Call only after the caller has confirmed the read back of area, building, bedrooms and current rent. Never calculate these figures yourself.

area.description: Dubai area or community as the caller confirmed it in the read back, in the caller's words, for example "JVC" or "Al Barsha South Fourth". Pass one name only, never two names together or a name in brackets. English or Arabic is fine.

building.description: Building name as the caller confirmed it in the read back, in the caller's words, for example "Triple A Residence" or "AAA Residence". Pass the building the caller named; never replace it with a different building. English or Arabic is fine.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms as the caller confirmed it in the read back, in the caller's words, for example "1 bedroom" or "1BR". English or Arabic is fine.

current_rent_aed.description: Current annual rent in UAE dirhams as a plain number with no commas or currency, as confirmed in the read back.

renewal_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date the current lease contract ends. Only include if the caller gave it and confirmed it.

notice_received_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date the caller received notice of the rent change. Only include if the caller gave it and confirmed it.
